checks.label: MFA bypass, recovery and session invalidation tests

Synthetic deployment rollback and worker-version recovery

records.title: Real-data portal activation
records.scope: Authorizes real PII upload, OCR processing, document storage, and worker identity management in the portal. Does not authorize public deployment, GitLab CI, or production infrastructure changes. Separate explicit approval required from operator, legal counsel, and sysadmin.
records.owner: product engineering + product owner + legal + sysadmin
records.implementation_gate_reason: Sprint 1 (P0 security), Sprint 2 (P1 DB/recovery), Sprint 3 (M3 completeness), Sprint 4 (M4/M5 gates) all required to pass before activation. See PLAN-REAL-DATA.
records.activation_gate_reason: Requires PLAN-REAL-DATA completion plus explicit operator/legal/sysadmin approval per real-data-rules.md.

checks.label: Sprint 1 P0 security and functional: capability enforcement, protected storage, OCR bytes-from-storage, immutable decisions, identity revisions
Sprint 2 P1 DB/recovery: migrations, composite tenant FKs, idempotency, locking, audit/outbox
Sprint 3 M3 completeness: IntakeItem, retention fields, translation coverage, WCAG 2.2 AA
Sprint 4 M4/M5 gates: A1 snapshots/artifacts, backup/restore, REV-002 approved
Operator trained; incident procedures and access protocols signed
Legal counsel reviewed and approved data processing basis
Encrypted backup verified: pg_dump + protected files + manifest + off-host copy + isolated restore
